text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty auto-page triggered: prometheus.scrape.failure for job=app-exporter-prod (fired 3x in 5m)
Maya: saw the page, joining. any obvious customer-facing dashboards down?
Aj: dashboards are showing metric gaps for api_latency_* and request_rate in prod-us-east-1, some panels went gray ~10:40 UTC.
Kai: confirmed. grafana zoom shows missing series starting 10:38. not total outage but 95th p99 traces missing for a bunch of hosts.
Maya: ok first step: is this exporter down or scrape failing? can someone check the target status in Prom?
Aj: running a quick prom query: `up{job=\"app-exporter-prod\"}` returns a bunch of 0s for the impacted hosts.
Aj: query: ```
up{job=\"app-exporter-prod\"} == 0
```
Kai: also checked prometheus logs, seeing repeated 404 when hitting /metrics on several endpoints. looks like exporter path changed?
SRE-bot: Incidentbot ran autorestart attempt on prometheus-scrape-manager at 10:42 UTC (attempt 1) - result: restart succeeded for scrape-manager-pod-3, but target still 404.
Maya: interesting. if the path changed due to recent deploy of the app, scrapers would see 404. any recent deploys around 10:30-10:35?
Aj: deploy-bot: release/feature/metrics-relabelling was deployed 10:31 by @eng-platform (automated). That PR touched exporter config and changed metrics path mapping. linking PR: <https://git.internal/repo/PR/4521>.
Kai: that PR looks like it added a relabel to drop the `instance` label for some hosts; maybe exporter now requires vendor-specific path `/custom/metrics` vs `/metrics`?
Maya: ok mitigation plan: 1) silence noisy alerts to stop spam, 2) escalate if customer impact persists, 3) quick rollback or patch of exporter endpoints.
Maya: silencing alert rule for job=app-exporter-prod for 30m to stop auto-paging. -> `alertmanager silence add --matchers=alertname=PrometheusScrapeFailure,job=app-exporter-prod --duration=30m`
Kai: doing silence now. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Silence added by Maya (30m) - PagerDuty alerts suppressed.
Aj: reached out in #product-ops - heard back that the deploy was a canary that rolled faster than expected. ops thinks a feature flag toggled path change.
Maya: next, can we hit one of the exporter endpoints directly from the prometheus scrape pod to confirm *what* it's returning? Aj, can you curl from prometheus?
Aj: done. ```
curl -sS http://10.25.1.42:9100/metrics | head -n 5
# HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
<html>...custom path required...</html>
```
Kai: confirms 404 with short HTML response that mentions `/internal/metrics` path. so exporters changed endpoints.
Maya: two mitigation options: rollback the canary (fast) or update scrape job relabel/metrics_path to the new path (also fast but risk mismatch). what's fastest?
Aj: canary rollback via deploy-bot is quick. initiating rollback for release/feature/metrics-relabelling now. deploy-bot: `rollback release/feature/metrics-relabelling to previous` in progress.
SRE-bot: Deploy-bot: rollback triggered at 10:49 UTC, rollout started.
Kai: while rollback runs, we should patch prometheus scrape config for the job in fleet to use `/internal/metrics` as a stopgap for affected hosts. I can push a configmap patch to prometheus-scrape for prod-us-east-1.
Maya: do it, but document change in the ticket and plan to revert when rollback completes.
Aj: patch applied to prom configmap and prometheus reloaded at 10:52 UTC. quick check of `up{job=\"app-exporter-prod\"}` now shows many 1s returning.
Aj: ```
up{job=\"app-exporter-prod\"} == 1
```
Kai: dashboards are recovering; panels filling in. customer-facing impact looks mitigated.
Maya: excellent. PD: can we update PagerDuty incident status? who acked?
oncall-lead: I acked the page at 10:43 (PD#INC-9821) before silence added - thanks Maya. marking incident as mitigated pending rollback success.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-9821 acknowledged by oncall-lead at 10:43 UTC.
Maya: next actions: 1) wait for rollback to finish and confirm no further rollouts, 2) follow-up with platform to ensure deploys have guardrails for metrics path changes, 3) create a post-incident task to add a canary probe for metric endpoints in CI.
Aj: rollback succeeded at 10:58 UTC per deploy-bot. verifying: scrapes stable for 10m.
Kai: creating follow-up ticket: PLAT-1178 "prevent metrics path regressions + add canary probe" assigned to eng-platform. I'll add logs and snippets.
Maya: tagging customer-impact: a small set of dashboards (billing, latency) in prod-us-east-1 showed gaps for ~20m, no SLA breach reported yet but notify customer-ops.
Aj: sending note to cs-alerts: "Metrics gaps observed 10:38-10:58 UTC in prod-us-east-1, recovery after config rollback and scrape patch. Investigating root cause - platform deploy changed exporter path."
SRE-bot: Summary: mitigated by temporary scrape-path patch + rollback. Root cause: deployment changed exporter endpoint without coordinating prometheus scrape config. Severity: Sev3. Follow-ups: PLAT-1178, add pre-deploy metric smoke test, improve deploy PR checklist.
Maya: thanks everyone. I'll hand off to next on-call in 30m and mark this thread for postmortem notes. If anything reoccurs, ping in this thread.
oncall-lead: will take follow-ups. closing incident in PD as resolved at 11:05 UTC.
Kai: adding final logs and command snippets to PLAT-1178 and tagging eng-platform.
Maya: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
